children.name: Build intake object graph
children.script:
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.util.Base64
char stx=(char)0x02; char etx=(char)0x03
def contact=vars.get('contact_master_object'); def vehicle=vars.get('vehicle_master_object'); def caseObj=vars.get('case_master_object')
def p='ALLCONTACT:CONTACT:'+contact+etx+'VEHICLE::'+vehicle+etx+'NJS::inv_njs_id#'+vars.get('inv_njs_id_1')+'#'+stx+'inv_njs_id#'+vars.get('inv_njs_id_2')+'#'+etx+'LOCATION::location_id#'+vars.get('case_location_id')+'#LOCATION'+etx+'CASE:CASE:'+caseObj
def d='ALLCONTACT:CONTACT:'+contact+stx+'VEHICLE::'+vehicle+stx+'NJS::inv_njs_id:'+vars.get('inv_njs_id_1')+':inv_njs_id#'+vars.get('inv_njs_id_1')+'#'+stx+'NJS::inv_njs_id:'+vars.get('inv_njs_id_2')+':inv_njs_id#'+vars.get('inv_njs_id_2')+'#'+stx+'LOCATION::location_id:'+vars.get('case_location_id')+':location_id#'+vars.get('case_location_id')+'#LOCATION'+stx+'CASE:CASE:'+caseObj
vars.put('objects_parameter',Base64.encoder.encodeToString(p.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))); vars.put('objects_data_index',Base64.encoder.encodeToString(d.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)))
